description:
*"Was I only your hyung when you were fucking me? You only treat me like an adult—and your hyung—at times like this?"*

Due to their parents' remarriage, Seon-woo and Ji-hyun go from being "the boys next door" to "brothers on paper."
For ten years, they have been tangled together physically more intensely than anyone else, yet to Seon-woo, Ji-hyun was nothing more and nothing less than "the cute, broad-shouldered younger guy next door who's great in bed."

Terrified of the responsibility and feelings that come with a deeper relationship, Seon-woo has drifted from man to man, desperately turning a blind eye to Ji-hyun's heavy, sincere devotion. To make matters worse, when their parents' remarriage prompts Seon-woo to show signs of cutting Ji-hyun off completely—even as a sex partner—Ji-hyun, who has held back for a decade, finally snaps.

Normally foul-tempered and arrogant, the younger man sheds tears like a child as he pours out ten years of pent-up heartache. Seon-woo, who had been mocking Ji-hyun under a facade of nonchalance, is finally forced to confront the massive reality of the feelings he had been avoiding in the face of Ji-hyun's desperate confession.

What awaits at the end of this relentless avoidance—salvation, or a black hole from which there is no escape?

A fierce and desperate tale of shifting power dynamics between two men who shatter taboos and sink into each other's abyss. *(Source: RIDI, translated)*
